name: 111 會考模擬二模（翰林 1～4 冊）英語閱讀
source: 翰林 111 學年國中教育會考模擬測驗（範圍 1～4 冊），答案與解析取自官方試題分析
passages:
Below is what Arya saw on a video website.（網頁內容見附圖）
（website 網頁　according to 根據　local 本地人）

You Can’t Live Without Vitamin C
How much vitamin C can we take a day? About 60 mg a day is enough. Our body can take no more than 200 mg a day.
What should we know about taking vitamin C? 1. Don’t take it before meals. 2. Have enough water.
Why do we need vitamin C? Keep the cold away. / Make skin whiter. / Keep tooth and lip problems away. / Heart problems won’t happen easily. / Help our body take more nutrients.
Food with vitamin C (every 100 g): Guava 137 mg, Orange 74 mg, Strawberry 69 mg, Papaya 58 mg, Lemon 34 mg, Red pepper 137 mg, Broccoli 75 mg
（vitamin 維他命　skin 皮膚　nutrient 營養）

As a student or an office worker, you sit at the desk for so many hours every day. After school or work, you must feel tired and have a sore back. Now, I am going to tell you how to relax your sore back by doing marjaryasana.
　　First, start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position. Begin with your knees on the mat. Make sure your knees are below your hips. Put your hands on the mat right under your shoulders, and your arms and shoulders are in line. Look straight ahead.
　　Second, after you get ready, breathe out the air and round your back up. At the same time face down the floor. Be sure to keep your shoulders and knees in the same place as the first position. And then breathe in and come back to the first position. Repeat ten times.
　　It’s easy, and it is also good to do “marjaryasana” on the bed after you get up. Let’s do it and relax at home!
（relax 放鬆　position 姿勢　mat 地毯　hip 臀部　breathe 呼吸）

（八格漫畫，見附圖）
1 Nancy: Nick, look at those people. They are wearing special glasses. 【That】 makes them look strange.
2 Nick: They are watching the sun.
3 Nancy: The sun?
4 Nick: Yeah, don’t you notice the sun getting darker and darker? In fact, today in Taiwan, we can see an annular solar eclipse.
5 Nancy: Annular solar eclipse? What is that?
6 Nick: When the moon stands between and in line with the Earth and the sun, an annular solar eclipse happens. If you see through the special glasses, the sun looks like a beautiful ring.
7 Nancy: Wow, sounds interesting. Nick: Maybe we should join them. The chance of seeing an annular solar eclipse is slim. If we miss it, we’ll have to wait two hundred years.
8 Both: Let’s go!

Happy Farm is famous for its beautiful hills with hundreds of sheep around. People come here to get close to nature. Children like here because they can touch and feed the cute sheep on the farm. Also, there are several shows at the squares for visitors to watch and have some fun. At Sun Square is our most famous Sheep Shearing Show, at Star Square is Sheep Feeding Show, and at Moon Square is Horse Riding Show. We hold each show twice a day. To get to those squares, you have to take the stairs, and you can find them along Happy Road.
　　If you would like to take your time enjoying nature at the farm, it is a good idea to stay for the night. We recommend you watch the shows at Star and Moon Square for the first day, and then check in at the glamping area at four. Here you will stay in a big and comfortable camp, with beds and a bathroom inside, and you can have our delicious dinner and breakfast. The next day, take the stairs to watch the show at Sun Square right next to the glamping area.
（農場地圖見附圖）
（shear 剪切　recommend 推薦）

What will you do if you pick up something on the street and find it is someone else’s? Most people may say they will find the person and give the thing back or hand it in to the police, but what about money? If you happen to pick up money on the street, will you do the same?
　　A newspaper in Canada wanted to know the answer, so they started a “test” to find out where the most honest people in Canada are. The newspaper sent reporters to drop ten wallets full of money in ten Canadian cities. There was a card with a name and a phone number in each wallet. The reporters then hid around and waited to see if there would be anyone calling to send the wallet back. In the end, the reporters found 60% of the people would give the money back after they picked up the wallet. But the others would take away the money in the wallet.
　　The reporters also found that women were more likely to give back the money. But most young people, men or women, kept the money and did not care to make the phone call. Among the ten cities, people from Moncton had a clear conscience. Toronto and Vancouver were the two cities with the lowest percentage(%) of people giving back the money. It turned out that, from the newspaper’s test, the answer was Moncton, the small town in the far west of Canada.
（likely 可能　among 在…之中）

Did you ever see a walking popcorn? In Andreas Kay’s video, you can see one walking on its fingers! In fact, it is a baby Flatid Planthopper Nymph insect. It looks like a small cloud or a piece of popcorn resting on little insect legs. There is a reason for this strange look—the insect is covered with white wax to keep itself safe. The insects live in Amazon rainforest, but it’s not easy to see them because they are very small (about 1 cm), and they can jump far and fast between plants (but they walk slowly). They feed on plant juice, but they don’t hurt plants. They are really interesting, aren’t they?
---------
　　There are many kinds of special animals in the Amazon rainforest, and the glass frog (Hyalinobatrachium fleischmanni) is one of them. Why does it get the name? Because its abdomen skin is transparent, just like glass! You can clearly see its body parts, like the stomach and the heart, through its skin. More than that, its eggs are transparent, too! Glass frogs are about 2－3 cm long, so it’s hard for us to notice them. Besides, they are really good at climbing. Come to the Taipei Zoo, and you can see the cute little frog in person!
（wax 蠟　rainforest 雨林　abdomen skin 腹部皮膚）

NNC NEWS　2021/10/28
　　Two years ago, a moose appeared on the screen of the camera in a national park in Colorado, the USA. People in the national park noticed it because __40__. Before they could do anything about it, the moose went away. Once in a while the moose would appear on the screen, and they found it was a tire.
　　Luckily, a team found the moose, and they tried to take off the tire from it. However, its body and antlers were so big, and it was not possible to take the tire off through its head or body. So, __41__. But they found there was a steel ring inside the tire, and it was hard to cut it off. Then they chose to cut off its antlers, and the moose was finally free from the tire.
　　You might be thinking that it was not a good idea to cut off the antlers. __42__ In early spring, antlers of moose will fall off and they will grow new ones back. Male moose count on beautiful antlers to find lovers. Though this moose with a tire could still eat and drink, __43__. After a long winter, it can finally enjoy love, just like other moose now.
（moose 駝鹿　tire 輪胎　antler 鹿角　steel 鋼　male 雄性的）

questions.q: Look at the picture. George is dancing with ______.
questions.e: 按照圖片所示，與「戴眼鏡的男子」跳舞，正確答案為(B)。(A)穿短褲的男孩(B)戴眼鏡的男子(C)穿洋裝的女子(D)留長髮的女孩。故選(B)。

questions.q: I didn’t check the news ______ I went out, so I didn’t know my train to Taipei stopped until I got to the station.
questions.e: 我出門「前」沒有確認新聞，所以直到我到達火車站我才知道到臺北的火車停駛了。(A)在…之前(B)但是(C)否則(D)雖然。故選(A)。

questions.q: My ______ is watering. I can’t wait to eat the delicious food on the plate.
questions.e: 我的「嘴巴」在流口水了。我迫不及待要吃餐盤上的美食了。(A)眼睛(B)嘴巴(C)鼻子(D)牙齒。故選(B)。

questions.q: Turn around and take a look, Sam. There’s a cute cat ______ you.
questions.e: 由 turn around（轉身），推知貓在 Sam 的「後面」，選(D)。(A)在…上方(B)橫過(C)沿著(D)在…後面。

questions.q:
Ben: How many people ______ over for tonight’s dinner, Amy?
Amy: Twelve. I told you last night, honey. We need to prepare enough food.
questions.e: 有多少人今晚要來吃晚餐，用 are coming 表示即將發生的事情，(C)應改為 will come(D)應改為 are going to come。故選(B)。

questions.q: Our teacher asked us to look at problems from different ______. This way, we might fix them more easily.
questions.e: 我們老師要我們從不同的「角度」看待問題。這樣才能更輕易解決它們。(A)角度(B)答案(C)空白(D)服務。故選(A)。

questions.q: Housewives usually have a ______ check on everything when they do shopping. They want to get the best deals.
questions.e: 家庭主婦們通常在購物時會「仔細」檢查所有的物品。她們希望買得最划算。(A)便宜的(B)仔細的(C)舒服的(D)方便的。故選(B)。

questions.q:
Alice: ______ do you exercise each time?
Ben: Only half an hour, but I always exercise three times a day.
questions.e: 由回答的 Only half an hour 可知原問句為 How long 表示詢問做某件事持續多久。故選(C)。

questions.q: The poor girl lost all her family in the fire. People in the town are ______ money to help her.
questions.e: 可憐的女孩在火災失去所有的家人。鎮上的人們正在「募集」款項幫助她。(A)建立(B)輸掉(C)募集(D)拿走。故選(C)。

questions.q: I saw a man put the box at the door, but I didn’t ______ know who he was.
questions.e: 我看到一位男子把那個箱子放在門口，但是我「實際上」不知道他是誰，選(A)。(A)實際上(B)最後(C)幸運地(D)安靜地。

questions.q: I don’t think Mom will allow us to join the party if we ______ our bedroom by Friday.
questions.e: if 條件句用現在簡單式表達未來的事，選(A)。

questions.q: Ivy’s birthday is on February 29th. She can only have her birthday party every four years. Her ______ birthday is finally coming and she will be twelve years old next week.
questions.e: 文中提到 Ivy 每四年過一次生日，下禮拜就是她的 12 歲生日，故可推知她的第三個生日即將來到，故選(B)。

questions.q: Nancy is buying a train ticket because she will ______ Taipei tomorrow.
questions.e: Nancy 正在購買火車票因為她明天將「前往」臺北。(A)上車(B)大叫(C)尋找(D)前往。故選(D)。

questions.q: I didn’t like this picture, so Henry gave me ______. He said I had to choose between them because there was no more.
questions.e: 我不喜歡這張圖，所以 Henry 給我「另一張」。他說我必須從中做選擇因為沒有更多了。由語意可知只有兩張可以做選擇，因此是選有限定的另一個 the other。故選(D)。

questions.q: Jerry and Mia broke up for some ______. They didn’t tell us what happened. We guess it’s because of their family.
questions.e: Jerry 和 Mia 因為某種「原因」分手了。他們沒有告訴我們發生什麼事。我們在猜是因為他們的家人。由推測原因，推知答案為(D)。(A)選擇(B)經驗(C)項目(D)原因。故選(D)。

questions.q: Mrs. Wang couldn’t bear to see her grandson cry, so she ______ him eat some ice cream without telling the boy’s mother.
questions.e: Mrs. Wang 不忍看到孫子哭，所以她「讓」他吃一些冰淇淋而沒有告訴男孩的母親。(B)不符合情境；(C)(D)須使用不定詞 to V。故選(A)。

questions.q: Joe worked for over ten hours every day last month. It almost ______ him his life. He won’t work long hours any more.
questions.e: 事 cost one one’s life：某事使某人付出生命的代價，選(A)。

questions.q: I think the food in the blue pot might taste ______. Those kids liked both the dishes, but they finished all the food in the blue pot but left some in the white one.
questions.e: 我覺得藍色鍋子的食物可能嘗起來「比較美味」。那些孩子兩道餐點都喜歡，但他們把藍色鍋子裡的食物全吃完了，白色鍋子的還剩了一些。連綴動詞後接形容詞，又從語意判斷可知是比較兩個鍋子裡的食物，故選比較級(B)。故選(B)。

questions.q: Ernest is looking for a place for the party with his friends. He plans to have a big meal with them and bring his pet dog along. What words should he type in to look for the information on the Net?
questions.e: Ernest 正在為和朋友的派對尋找一個地方。他計畫和他們享用大餐並帶他的寵物狗去。由題意可推知需要找一間寵物友善的餐廳，故選(D)。(A)寵物護理(B)寵物食物(C)寵物醫院(D)寵物友善餐廳。

questions.q:
When reading a story, Zac saw the word “flat” and didn’t know what it meant.
“After the exciting five-day trip, Mindy went back to her common life—work, family, work, family. She felt her life was so flat. How she missed those five days!”
He found several meanings of the word in a dictionary. Which one should Zac choose?
o: Not very deep, thick, or high.
questions.e: 在五天興奮的旅行後回到一般的生活，不是工作就是家庭生活，可推知是覺得生活太「平淡（不有趣）」。(A)沒氣(B)沒電(C)不有趣(D)不是很深、很厚或很高。故選(C)。

questions.q: According to the list “You may also like these,” which topic may Arya be interested in?
questions.e: 根據列表列出的三個影片，皆是有關各地美食，可知她喜歡的應是有關「食物」的主題。故選(A)。

questions.q: Below are pictures from the video “Uphone 11 Unboxing.” What does unbox mean according to the pictures?
o: Teaching others how to clean cellphones.
Showing others what a new item looks like.
questions.e: 由影片提到新手機，及介紹手機外觀跟螢幕顏色，可知 unbox 是指跟他人分享新商品的樣子，也就是「開箱」的意思。故選(D)。

questions.q: Arya watched one of the videos on the website, and below is what she saw in the video. Whose video did she watch?
questions.e: 圖片是在吃麵，且最後有提到去 Gotham City 不能錯過，可知是在看 Mindy Chen 的影片介紹當地人最愛的 6 個小吃攤。故選(D)。

questions.q: What can we learn about vitamin C from the picture?
o: It is better to take vitamin C right after you get up.
Taking more than 200 mg a day doesn’t help us more.
Take vitamin C every day, and we won’t have heart attacks.
questions.e: 圖表提到人體一天最多只能吸收 200 mg 的維他命 C，故可推知吃超過不會比較好，選(C)。(A)蔬菜也有(B)餐前不要吃(D)是不容易有，不代表不會有。

questions.q: Why is the list of “Food with vitamin C” put in the picture?
o: To tell us where to buy good food.
To show us what to eat to get vitamin C.
To let us know what the most popular fruit is.
To tell us how many kinds of fruits and vegetables to eat a day.
questions.e: 此圖表在介紹維他命 C 的好處，接著列出含有維他命 C 的蔬果，故可推知是要告訴我們吃什麼可以獲得維他命 C。故選(B)。

questions.q: From the reading, which picture best shows marjaryasana?
questions.e: 由第二段「第二，準備好後，吐氣並朝上圓背。同時臉往下看地板。確保你的肩膀和膝蓋在和第一個姿勢同樣的位置。」可知選(C)。

questions.q: Which is NOT true about marjaryasana from the reading?
o: We can’t move our knees when doing it.
It can also help relax our shoulders and hips.
We can do it both after work and after getting up.
We don’t look down on the floor in the first position.
questions.e: 文中只有提到貓式能幫助放鬆背部，並無提到也能放鬆肩膀和臀部，故選(B)。

questions.q: Which is an annular solar eclipse?
questions.e: 文中提到「如果妳透過這個特製眼鏡觀看，太陽看起來就像一個漂亮的戒指。」可推知，故選(D)。

questions.q: What does That mean?
questions.e: 由前句「他們穿戴很特別的眼鏡」可推知，That 指戴著眼鏡，故選(C)。

questions.q: Which is true?
o: Nancy and Nick are going to buy the special glasses.
It is very common to see an annular solar eclipse in Taiwan.
Nancy and Nick are going to watch an annular solar eclipse.
Nancy can see an annular solar eclipse without the special glasses.
questions.e: 由文末 Nancy 的回應可推知，兩人即將加入觀賞日環食的行列，故選(C)。(A)文章並未提及。(B)日環食的發生機率很低，並不常見。(D)必須透過眼鏡才能看到日環食。

questions.q: Some people like to take their time getting close to nature. What will the farm recommend to them?
o: Watching all the shows in one day.
Feeding the sheep along Happy Road.
questions.e: 文章第二段提到如果想放鬆點慢慢享受大自然，可以在這裡過夜住宿，故選(B)。

questions.q: What does the camp at the glamping area look like?
questions.e: 由後面的敘述提到大帳篷，且裡面有床和浴室，可推知選(C)。

questions.q: After getting to Happy Farm, Mike took a walk around it to watch the sheep on the hills. Now he is at the far north of the farm, and he decides to watch Sheep Feeding Show first and then Horse Riding Show. Which way is the fastest?
o: Stairs A → Stairs C → Stairs D.
Stairs B → Stairs D → Stairs E.
Stairs C → Stairs D → Stairs B.
Stairs B → Stairs D → Stairs C.
questions.e: 要先看在 Star 廣場的餵食秀，要走 B 樓梯，再去 Moon 廣場看騎馬秀，從 Star 廣場走樓梯 D 再走樓梯 C 可到達，選(D)。

questions.q: What is this reading about?
o: Showing the findings of a study.
Talking about some cities in Canada.
Inviting people to join a newspaper’s test.
questions.e: 文章內容提及加拿大某家報社想要了解在加拿大哪一個城市的人們最誠實，因此進行了一項研究試驗來找出結果。而文章結論提出了此研究試驗的各項結果，因此最適合答案應為(B)。故選(B)。

questions.q: What may people with a clear conscience do?
o: They may be less likely to tell lies.
They may be more likely to join studies and tests.
They may like to give foreigners a hand if they need help.
They may be more likely to pick up someone else’s things on the street.
questions.e: 根據文章內容可知，在蒙克頓的人們還錢的意願比例最高，因此文章說到這裡的人們「最有良知」，而有良知的人是明是非之人，因此最可能選擇說實話而不願意說謊。故選(A)。

questions.q: After the reporters from the newspaper finished the test, they made four pictures. Which is NOT one of them?
questions.e: 根據文章最後一段該報社取得的研究結果可知，年長者，且無論男女，都比年輕的人們更願意把撿到的錢歸還，因此可知圖(C)年輕女性及年輕男性還錢的比例都比年長者高，此一資訊和測試結果不吻合，故非記者所製作的圖表。故選(C)。

questions.q: If something is transparent, what does it mean?
o: It can jump far and fast.
People can see almost everything inside it.
questions.e: transparent 後面的描述說像玻璃一樣，可以看到身體裡的東西，可知此字是指「透明的」，可以看到裡面的東西。故選(D)。

questions.q: Sean is at the zoo with his parents, and he wants to see both glass frogs and popcorn insects. Which area of the zoo should he visit?
questions.e: 文中提到爆米花蟲是住在亞馬遜雨林，玻璃蛙也能在亞馬遜雨林找到，故要去動物園的「雨林區」才能看到這兩種動物。故選(B)。

questions.q: Sean took notes on the information above. What can he write at the bottom of the column?（column 欄）
questions.e: 兩者都有提到身體大小，故選(A)。(B)只有提到玻璃蛙的卵(C)只有提到爆米花蟲吃什麼(D)兩者皆未提及。

questions.q: 空格 40 應填入：
o: it looked like a giant horse
it had something around its neck
it ate lots of grass in the national park
it fought with other moose all the time
questions.e: 由下文我們可以知道這隻駝鹿會被注意到，是因為國家公園的人發現在牠脖子上的是個輪胎（they found it was a tire），故選(B)有某個東西在牠的脖子上。

questions.q: 空格 41 應填入：
o: they decided to cut off the tire
they gave up taking off the tire
they turned to save another moose
they gave the moose some medicine
questions.e: 下文提到發現輪胎內有鋼圈很難切開（But they found there was a steel ring inside the tire, and it was hard to cut it off.），可知是在切開輪胎時發現的，故選(A)他們決定切開輪胎。

questions.q: 空格 42 應填入：
questions.e: 上文提到讀者可能會覺得切斷鹿角不好，下文提到每年初春角都會脫落並長出新角，因此這裡應是要讀者「不要擔心」。故選(C)。

questions.q: 空格 43 應填入：
o: it couldn’t find its way home
it couldn’t sleep well every night
it couldn’t find lovers with the tire
it couldn’t run as fast as other moose
questions.e: 上文提到雄鹿是靠鹿角來找到愛人，下文提到這隻駝鹿終於可以跟其他駝鹿一樣享受愛情了，可知此處是指「有這個輪胎牠無法找到伴侶」。故選(C)。
